args: [PROACTIVE-JUDGE-SHADOW] Weekday 08:35 local (America/Chicago) post-sweep Judge & queue resolution for the ctrld-sync pilot (2B, shadow-ledger + two-tier state transitions). Do NOT push, open PRs, or re-run the sweep. Steps: (1) Resolve SWEEP_DATE via `__HOME__/.gemini/config/proactive/scripts/antigravity-proactive-ctl.sh sweep-date --cron 'CRON_TZ=America/Chicago 15 8 * * 1-5'` and check __HOME__/.gemini/antigravity/proactive-reports/$SWEEP_DATE-ctrld-sync.md. (2) If no digest exists, run `__HOME__/.gemini/config/proactive/scripts/antigravity-proactive-ctl.sh audit-missed --date "$SWEEP_DATE" --repo ctrld-sync --cron 'CRON_TZ=America/Chicago 15 8 * * 1-5'` once. (3) Run `__HOME__/.gemini/config/proactive/scripts/antigravity-proactive-ctl.sh judge --repo ctrld-sync --date "$SWEEP_DATE" --cron 'CRON_TZ=America/Chicago 15 8 * * 1-5'` to evaluate all UNJUDGED candidate worktrees across Tier 1 (merge-tree, check-collisions, ocr delegate preview, gitnexus-review) and Tier 2 (ocr review, CodeRabbit, plus sparing LiveReview `lrc` only on eligible tie-breakers; never transmit sentinel diffs to cloud reviewers), run base-check automatically on any provisional GATE_FAILURE verify failure not already decided by the policy probe, retire JUDGE_REJECT regressions, transition JUDGE_PASS_ROUTINE / JUDGE_ESCALATE_HUMAN worktrees to JUDGED, auto-expire >7d JUDGED worktrees on disk, and append 0600 receipts to judge-shadow-ledger.jsonl. (4) Post a TIGHT summary with: repo, Status, Substatus, Judge Verdict(s), Queue Health (unjudged_open, judged_open, expired_preserved), verify exit code, diff size (files/+/-), and a one-line call: 'worth a look' or 'skip'. Never print secrets or sentinel details beyond Status and local digest path.
description: Every weekday (Mon-Fri) at 08:35 local (America/Chicago, 20 minutes post-sweep), runs the automated Judge across ctrld-sync digests and unjudged candidate worktrees.
